label: Heart of the City Specific Plan
source_context_text: The Heart of the City Specific Plan provides specific development guidance for one of the most important commercial corridors in the City of Cupertino, for the purpose of creating a greater sense of place and community identity in Cupertino. The plan contains streetscape design, development standards and design guidelines for multi-unit residential and commercial/office projects.

label: Monta Vista Design Guidelines
source_context_text: The Monta Vista Design Guidelines implement the policies of the General Plan by outlining building design details, landscaping treatment, signage and public improvement details for the Monta Vista Commercial Area.

label: Wireless Facilities Master Plan
source_context_text: The Wireless Facilities Master Plan was developed in 2003 as a guide for the public and for wireless companies. It is an educational tool for the public and a tool to facilitate the wireless companies and their representatives.

label: South Vallco planning area
source_context_text: The South Vallco planning area is an approximately 125-acre area bounded by I-280 to the north, Stevens Creek Boulevard to the south, including Cupertino Square shopping center (formerly Vallco Fashion Park) along the east and west side of Wolfe Road and the office development along the east side of Tantau Avenue. The area also includes office properties owned by Apple, Menlo Equities, as well as the Metropolitan residential/commercial development.

owner_heading: North Vallco Master Plan (not adopted by Council - for guidance only)
label: North Vallco planning are
source_context_text:
The North Vallco planning area is the 240-acre area bounded by Homestead Road, Tantau Avenue, I-280 and Wolfe Road. It includes the 100-acre Hewlett Packard campus, 50 acres acquired by Apple Computer for a future second campus, Cupertino Village shopping center, hotel, residential and office developments.

owner_heading: North De Anza Blvd Conceptual Plan
label: North De Anza Blvd Conceptual Plan
source_context_text: The North De Anza Blvd Conceptual Plan encompasses the stretch roughly between Interstate 280 and Stevens Creek Blvd. This plan provides direction on the streetscape expected of properties along North De Anza Boulevard.

owner_heading: S. De Anza Boulevard Conceptual Plan
label: S. De Anza Boulevard Conceptual Plan
source_context_text: S. De Anza Boulevard Conceptual Plan: Encompasses the stretch between Stevens Creek Blvd. and Bollinger Rd along De Anza Blvd.

label: South Sunnyvale-Saratoga Conceptual Zoning Plan
source_context_text: The South Sunnyvale-Saratoga Conceptual Zoning Plan covers the area south of Highway 85 along De Anza Blvd. The plan specifies the Land Uses allowed in the area and the permit approval process. It also specifies landscaping standards for the area.

label: South Vallco Connectivity Plan
source_context_text: The South Vallco Connectivity Plan shows how new development within the Vallco Shopping District can improve connectivity to existing and approved development, and ensure connectivity to future development within the greater area. The plan will help inform the development of the future Vallco Shopping District Specific and/or Master Plan.
